name: Tayori Nursing
description: Tayori Nursing — a block theme for a home-visit nursing service. Warm grey ground with scattered pebble-masked photographs and two hand-drawn doodles, a wide celadon wave that carries the headline, a statement whose lines fill from grey to ink as you scroll, a sticky heading with pill index tabs beside tall white rounded cards, a morning round, a four-step care plan, a fee table, stories and the team. Manrope for headings, Public Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
